response.reason: The workload is a cancellation trap: rows contain exact ±(1..32)*2^20 pairs plus tiny 0.25-granularity values, so the true row sums are ~8-32 while intermediate float32 accumulators reach ~2^25-2^29. The kernel does a naive sequential float32 sum, so each 0.25/0.5/0.75 addition when the accumulator is large gets rounded at ulp up to 4-32, producing per-row errors of the same order as the reference itself, likely violating E <= 0.1.
